newsitem.title: INDONESIA: S&P rates Tjiwi Kimia $400 mln notes at BB.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Tjiwi Kimia $400 mln notes at BB.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it had assigned a BB rating to $400 million of senior notes due 2004 which have been guaranteed by Indonesian paper company PT Pabrik Kertas Tjiwi Kimia.

"The rating reflects Tjiwi Kimia's strong position in the Indonesian writing and printing paper and stationery markets, strong growth prospects and a high level of operational integration within the Asia Pulp and Paper Co Ltd group," S&P said in a statement.
It added however that Asia Pulp's ambitious growth strategy and aggressive financial position somewhat offset the outlook.

However it added: "The group's satisfactory operating performance is sustainable, based on low-cost operations and high-growth end markets. Operating cash flows will remain cyclical and leverage will continue to be aggressive, reflecting the group's planned capacity growth and consequent demand for capital."
